          about

          All of this music is available to you to use in your projects! There are only three things you need to do...

          1) Credit "Sounds Like An Earful" as the author

          2) Link to our website (soundslikeanearful.com) so that other creators can find us.

          3) Consider becoming a Patreon member to support this project so that we can keep making and offering up new music!

          You can also find a lot more music like this at our website soundslikeanearful.com Happy creating!
